final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bw, COUNT(*) as rec_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), step2 AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bw) as avg_bandwidth, SUM(rec_count) as total_count FROM step1 GROUP BY lunarstage), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(total_count) as grand_total FROM step2) SELECT s2.lunarstage, s2.avg_bandwidth, s2.total_count, s2.total_count / CAST(s3.grand_total AS REAL) as ratio FROM step2 s2, step3 s3
